问题描述：布尔值字符串 true/false 前后有空格、制表符或换行时也应该能够解析，大小写不敏感。其他内容仍应报 ValueError。
Expected behavior: 解析前应先去除字符串首尾空白（strip），再转为小写进行不敏感匹配；若去除后仍非 'true'/'false' 则抛错。
Frozen model-proposed test cases: [{"path": "api.py", "symbol": "read_flag", "args": [" true "], "kwargs": {}, "intent": "issue", "normalize": "identity", "expected": true}, {"path": "api.py", "symbol": "read_flag", "args": ["\tfalse\n"], "kwargs": {}, "intent": "issue", "normalize": "identity", "expected": false}, {"path": "api.py", "symbol": "read_flag", "args": ["TRUE"], "kwargs": {}, "intent": "issue", "normalize": "identity", "expected": true}]

   2 |     key = value.lower()
   3 |     if key not in {"true", "false"}:
   4 |         raise ValueError("unsupported flag")
   5 |     return key == "true"
[代码结束]
